bio: Wholehearted and dedicated, Cyril Molard aims to ensure that the diner enjoys their meal as much as a child devouring an ice cream! Every detail has been endlessly pondered over and then fine-tuned in this cosy, trendy establishment. Creative side dishes set out to showcase the flavours of outstanding produce. The chef may add whoomph to a dish with subtle additions of tangy acidity. When he cooks asparagus, you can be certain it will be the best you have ever tasted. The fish is cooked to perfection and the succulent side dishes are paired with sauces that err towards the classical in a bid to shine the spotlight on the main ingredient.
